Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc is Vietnam’s first and largest wildlife park built according to the international semi-wild safari model. This fascinating attraction offers nature exploration, insights into the behavior of thousands of animals, visits with baby animals, and spectacular performances.
1. Introduction to Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc, Vietnam’s Wildlife Park
Location: Bai Dai area, northwestern Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
Opening hours: 9:00 AM–4:00 PM, Monday through Sunday

Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc is Vietnam’s largest semi-wildlife conservation and care park, with a planned area of up to 500 hectares, including 380 hectares in its first phase. The park is now home to thousands of animals representing hundreds of species from around the world.
Vietnam’s largest wildlife park, Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc, covers 380 hectares in the northwestern part of Pearl Island.
Vinpearl Safari has two main zones:

Open Zoo: The Open Zoo is home to rare wild and native species from South Africa, India, Australia, Europe, and other regions. Designed in harmony with the national park’s natural landscape, it includes areas for birds, reptiles, crocodiles, primates, white lions, Asian elephants, camels, hippos, giant sable antelopes, long-horned cattle, spotted deer, and more.

Safari Zone: Occupying most of the park, the Safari Zone contains multiple habitats with different ecosystems and thousands of wild animals. Visitors observe the animals’ natural lives through the windows of a specialized safari bus.
Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc is a renowned wildlife park in Vietnam with two main experience zones: the Safari Zone and the Open Zoo.

2. Map and Directions to Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc
Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc is approximately 30 km from Duong Dong Ward, about a 40-minute bus ride. Visitors can take Vinpearl’s free scheduled shuttle bus from Duong Dong.
Alternatively, take a taxi or rent a self-drive car or motorbike. From Duong Dong Ward, follow Cach Mang Thang Tam Road toward Cua Can, turn left, and continue straight to Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc.

3. What Is Special about Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc?
Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc offers sightseeing, exploration, performances, shopping, and distinctive dining experiences, creating a complete and memorable journey for visitors of all ages.
3.1. Experience the “Humans in Cages, Animals Roaming Free” Safari
Experience location: Safari Zone
Time: 9:00 AM–3:20 PM

Exploring nature aboard the “humans in cages, animals roaming free” bus is one of the most exciting experiences at Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc. It offers an exceptionally authentic way to observe wild animals living naturally.

The bus carries you into lush forest and the territory of wild animals. Along the way, you can witness charming natural moments: lions playing together, giraffes strolling across the road, and rhinos relaxing in mud pools.
Explore nature on the “humans in cages, animals roaming free” bus at Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc.
>>> See also: What does Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc offer? A complete guide to activities, dining, and transportation.
3.2. Enjoy a Spectacular Animal Show
Location: Performance stage behind Flamingo Restaurant
Time: 10:00–10:30 AM and 2:00–2:30 PM (daily except Tuesday and Wednesday)

The animal show highlights the talents of birds, primates, and reptiles such as parrots, eagles, hornbills, otters, and yellow-cheeked gibbons. The engaging acts reveal fascinating behaviors and abilities while communicating an environmental conservation message in a distinctive way.
Enjoy talented performances by birds, primates, and reptiles in the animal show.
>>> Check the latest animal-show schedule so you do not miss these spectacular performances!
3.3. Meet and Interact with the Animals
Location: Giraffe Restaurant, elephant area, and ring-tailed lemur area
Fee: VND 30,000 per serving of food

At the largest wildlife park on Pearl Island, visitors can meet and interact with many lovable animals. You can become acquainted with and feed friendly giraffes, playful lemurs, powerful elephants, and more.
Meet and interact with friendly giraffes at Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc.
3.4. Join the Energetic and Wild Zulu Performance
Times and locations: Show 01: 9:20–9:50 AM, main gate (outside); Show 02: 11:20–11:50 AM, bird garden; Show 03: 3:30–3:50 PM, main gate (inside)
Show 01: 9:20–9:50 AM, main gate (outside)
Show 02: 11:20–11:50 AM, bird garden
Show 03: 3:30–3:50 PM, main gate (inside)

Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc vividly recreates the energetic, untamed dances of the Zulu people. The program creates a joyful atmosphere and introduces visitors to African culture. The friendly African performers are also happy to join guests for cheerful souvenir photos.
Join the vibrant atmosphere of the wild Zulu dance at Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc.
3.5. Visit Adorable Baby Animals
Location: Kid Zoo
Time: 9:00 AM–4:00 PM

In the cool, peaceful setting of the primeval forest, Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc has welcomed many generations of baby lions, rhinos, hippos, antelopes, gibbons, goats, sheep, and other animals. Specialists care for these young animals at Kid Zoo, where visitors can meet the adorable babies.
Visit many adorable baby animals at Kid Zoo.
3.6. Enjoy Diverse Dining and Shopping Experiences

Restaurants, food counters, and the shopping street at Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc make the journey more complete. Guests can rest and dine at Flamingo & Rhino Restaurant or enjoy a meal amid the forest at Giraffe Restaurant. The shopping street offers charming souvenirs bearing the distinctive character of Vinpearl Safari.
Remember your wildlife-park journey with charming souvenirs from the shops.
4. Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc Admission Prices
Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc admission includes unlimited same-day access to the animal conservation and care areas, performances, and complimentary use of luggage storage and wheelchairs.

With its vast setting amid primeval forest and numerous appealing experiences, Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc is an ideal addition to any Pearl Island itinerary. Here, visitors become immersed in unspoiled nature and observe the lives and behaviors of thousands of wild animals at close range.

As night falls, nature begins a magnificent symphony of wildlife: the lively flocking calls of flamingos, the quiet murmurs of zebras and antelopes seeking shelter, and the stealthy footsteps of a Bengal tiger mingling with rustling leaves beneath the shimmering night sky.
DISCOVER THE NOCTURNAL LIVES OF WILDLIFE

Get ready to enter the nighttime world of wildlife. Far from the quiet natural setting you may imagine, the animals’ nightlife is remarkably lively and full of fascinating surprises waiting to be discovered!

There are six flamingo species worldwide. Carotene, an orange pigment in their diet, gives their feathers their pink color. The English word “flamingo” comes from a Spanish term meaning “flame-colored.” The American flamingo is distinguished by its vivid pink plumage and has the deepest coloration of all flamingo species. When resting, flamingos often stand on one leg with their necks bent backward.
This mainly nocturnal animal usually rests in the shade or soaks in water during the day and comes out at night to forage. Its diet consists of seeds, fruit, and insects.

Elephants are highly intelligent and affectionate animals, renowned for remembering people and events for very long periods. Thick pads beneath their feet allow them to move almost silently despite their immense size. They spend most of the day eating and sleep only about two to four hours daily.

The tiger is the largest member of the cat family and typically lives alone. It usually hunts at night and has eyesight about six times sharper than a human’s. Its powerful forelimbs and heavily muscled shoulders deliver exceptionally strong swipes. Longer, highly flexible hind legs enable it to leap five to seven meters. Claws up to 10 cm long and canine teeth measuring 6.5–7.5 cm make the tiger a formidable predator. Tigers spend most of the day resting, averaging about 20 hours daily.

Their habitat is designed to resemble the African savanna. Lions are the most social of the big cats and live in prides. They are highly territorial and have powerful roars that carry over long distances. In the morning, they often roar loudly to display dominance and mark their territory; across the African grasslands, a lion’s roar can be heard up to eight kilometers away.

The giraffe is the world’s tallest land animal, recognizable by its remarkable height and long legs. Adults average four to five meters tall, with some reaching 5.5 meters. Their large, expressive eyes and gentle, approachable nature make them widely loved. Vinpearl Safari has welcomed the births of more than ten adorable giraffe calves.

Most common in East Africa, long-horned cattle are regarded as a symbol of wealth. Their enormous horns can grow up to two meters long and help dissipate heat, enabling the animals to adapt to Africa’s hot climate.

Zebras are herd animals that often live in small groups of six to ten and may gather into very large herds to travel and forage together. They can be feisty, sometimes biting or kicking nearby individuals, and are especially skilled at powerful backward kicks. Zebras also express emotions through their ears: upright when content, drooping when sad, and turned backward when frightened.

Because of its characteristically broad lips, this species is also called the “wide-mouthed” or “square-lipped” rhinoceros. White rhinos often live in groups, grazing, resting, wallowing in mud, and even defecating communally. They also use their hind feet to scatter their own dung, leaving scent on grass and soil as they move and tending to follow familiar scent-marked paths—an important form of communication within the group. Their eyesight is poor, but their senses of smell and hearing are excellent.

Most primates forage, climb, and remain active during the day, then rest together high in the trees at night. In the darkness, visitors need to observe carefully to spot them quietly hidden among the treetops. In addition to the highlighted species above, the Night Safari journey also offers views of a remarkably diverse range of antelopes and other wildlife.

Introduction
Explore the Sea King’s giant turtle-shaped palace, featuring five fascinating ocean worlds that recreate the deep seabed and house 255,000 rare marine creatures.
Total area: 15,000 m² across three floors. Designed by two world-leading firms: Legacy GGE (USA) and AAT (Australia).
A MAIN TANK RANKED AMONG THE WORLD’S FIVE LARGEST AQUARIUM TANKS

Experience a magnificent ocean world through one of the world’s five largest aquarium tanks, featuring a massive 200 m² acrylic viewing panel and a volume of up to 15,500 m³. Marvel as thousands of fish swim through the vast space, and enjoy an enchanting mermaid performance and a spectacular fish-feeding show.
WALK THROUGH THE HEART OF THE OCEAN

When you enter the Sea Shell, you do more than simply view the ocean—you become immersed in a vivid deep-sea world. Thousands of marine creatures glide before your eyes, while glass tunnels reveal dreamlike scenes in endless shades of blue. Without diving, you can still feel the rhythm of the sea, encounter its inhabitants at remarkably close range, and create one-of-a-kind memories on your Phu Quoc journey.
VISIT THE PENGUIN “ARMY”

Step into a frozen world that brings together six penguin species from around the globe and meet some of the ocean’s most adorable residents. From rare emperor penguins to the world’s fastest-swimming Gentoo penguins, they can all be observed at very close range. Do not miss feeding time, when the whole “army” creates delightfully funny and endearing moments.

Introduction
Recreating the finest elements of Vietnamese culture through modern performance art, advanced sound and lighting technology, and 3D projection

Immerse yourself in cultural stories told through soaring performances that use cutting-edge technology and unique equipment: a stage on water, movable building facades, a zipline, 3D mapping, and state-of-the-art lighting and sound effects.
Travel back through space and time to discover the quintessence of Vietnamese heritage.

Passing through the gate feels like stepping into a historical film that recreates an ancient imperial city. At the Quintessence of Vietnam, the concept is not “new construction” but a faithful restoration of the finest elements of traditional Vietnamese culture. From the architecture, communal courtyard, and tiled roofs to every tree and blade of grass, the setting is recreated according to historic models.

The Quintessence of Vietnam is designed as an ancient village with front and rear gates, bamboo ramparts, and a royal palace. Every paving brick is handmade and intentionally uneven to recreate the familiar courtyards of old Vietnam. Even drain covers—an easily overlooked detail—are carefully fashioned from aged bricks, drilled and cut to the required dimensions.
Vietnamese customs, legends, and historical allusions come vividly to life in an ancient Vietnamese setting through a series of daytime and nighttime performances.

Visitors experience everyday life inside an ancient imperial city and become part of the story. The stalls bustle each day, with every performer portraying a resident of the old citadel who trades and goes about daily life from 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

Many visitors think the Quintessence of Vietnam is simply the name of the USD 8.3 million live show staged daily at 8:15 PM. In fact, it is a complex of performance stages, experiential shopping stalls, and reconstructed historical architecture, offering activities from morning to night and centered on the multimedia live show of the same name.

GENERAL INFORMATION
Immerse yourself in a romantic love story along the poetic canals of Venice, recreating the splendor of Italy.

The Lake of Love hosts experiences that capture Grand World’s bright yet gentle daytime rhythm, from masquerade celebrations to spontaneous operatic melodies rising from a gondola. When night falls, Colors of Venice takes over the unique stage at the center of the lake and delivers a spectacular feast for every sense.
Marvel at a performance on water featuring some of the world’s most advanced lighting effects.

Become immersed in the love story of a painter and a young noblewoman beside the canals of Venice, brought vividly to life through LED technology and 3D mapping on a magical mist screen. The story carries audiences through an escalating succession of emotional peaks.
Admire distinctive dances by professional performers in exquisitely crafted European-style costumes with elaborate props.

The boat procession departs from the entrance arch and follows the canal toward the Lake of Love. Characters in glowing LED costumes appear aboard the gondolas, creating the scene of a magical festival night.
Venice Dance

After the brilliantly colored boat procession reaches the shore, young couples join an endless celebration and dance a romantic waltz. At the ball, they meet, fall in love, and exchange promises.

The two main characters join the magical Venice Carnival and its magnificent procession, becoming immersed together in a romantic waltz across the Lake of Love.
Moonlight Ball
Moonlight Ball

After their romantic duet, the painter and the young noblewoman join the lively party. She is captivated by the music and the musicians’ masterful dancing. In the excitement, the painter loses sight of the love of his life and searches tirelessly for her amid the bustling festival.
The Vow
The Vow

Guided by the gentle sound of the piano, the painter finds the young noblewoman again during the colorful ball. He proposes in the romantic setting, and they pledge to remain together for life, exploring the world and painting a beautiful fairy-tale love story.
Dance of Light
Dance of Light
After the romantic proposal, the couples continue celebrating in Grand World’s colorful festival with dazzling laser effects and energetic music.
Costumes

Street Circus Clown Group: Made from suede and taffeta with elaborate details such as lace, pearls on hats, masks, hoods, and boots, each costume becomes a work of art that recreates Renaissance culture.
Street Circus Clown Group

The Queen: All costumes in Colors of Venice faithfully recreate the street-carnival attire of Venice. The Queen’s costume comprises seven elements: gown, underskirt, mask, scepter, gloves, shoes, and crown. Red and gold dominate the design. Made primarily from velvet specially imported from Italy, every detail is cut and sewn by hand.
The Queen

Noble Group: The female nobles’ costumes make a striking impression with lavish designs and vivid colors. Their highlights are broad skirts with voluminous underskirts, combined with intricate ornamentation that emphasizes elegance, grandeur, and authority.

Street Performance Group: These costumes not only faithfully reproduce Renaissance masquerade eveningwear but are also specially designed for performance in the 3D-mapping live show Colors of Venice.
